title: X402 Accepted Payment Methods Configuration
description: Configuration schema for Pro API x402-accepted-payment-methods-config.json. CAIP-2 network identifiers map to ERC-20 token contract addresses; each leaf object describes one accepted X402 payment method. The top-level `facilitators` object defines facilitator backends referenced by `facilitator_id`.

facilitators.description: Named facilitator backends. Keys are facilitator ids referenced by payment methods via `facilitator_id`. Values describe which environment variables hold the facilitator URL and optional API credentials.

additionalProperties.description: One facilitator backend. `url_env_key` is required; API key env vars are optional (used by authenticated facilitators such as Coinbase).

url_env_key.description: Name of the environment variable that contains the facilitator URL.

api_key_id_env_key.description: Name of the environment variable that contains the facilitator API key id.

api_key_secret_env_key.description: Name of the environment variable that contains the facilitator API key secret.

^[-a-z0-9]{3,8}:[-_a-zA-Z0-9]{1,32}$.description: Payment methods accepted on this CAIP-2 network. Keys are ERC-20 token contract addresses.

^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$.description: One accepted X402 payment method (one network + asset combination).

scheme.description: X402 payment scheme advertised to clients (e.g. 'exact').

network.description: CAIP-2 network id; must match the parent map key.

asset.description: ERC-20 token contract address; must match the inner map key.

payTo.description: Recipient address that should receive the token transfer.

maxTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time window (seconds) forwarded to clients in the payment requirement.

extra.description: Arbitrary metadata forwarded to clients as-is (e.g. EIP-712 name/version for transferWithAuthorization tokens like USDC).

usd_per_token.description: USD price of one whole token (human units, not wei). Used with billing credits and decimals to compute the on-chain amount at request time.

decimals.description: ERC-20 decimals of the token (e.g. 6 for USDC).

facilitator_id.description: Id of the facilitator backend from the top-level `facilitators` map that should settle this payment method.
